destinations.title: Hello, I’m Victor.
destinations.text:
I’m a software developer and problem solver. I like taking something tangled, understanding how it fits together, and making it workable.

My grounding is in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations and ERP. That means thinking beyond a single screen: requirements, people, processes, and what happens after the code ships.

A little off the main road

At home, I’m curious about Raspberry Pi servers, AI-assisted work, and useful web apps. This coast is an imaginary map of those interests—not a map of client projects.

destinations.title: From the question to the working thing.
destinations.text:
Good software starts with understanding what someone actually needs. I work through requirements and technical design, then implementation, testing, deployment and support.

My working rhythm
Clarify the requirement and its edges.
Make the design understandable.
Build, test, and coordinate across teams.
Stay attentive when it reaches real users.

Dynamics 365 F&O / ERP is my professional foundation. I’m interested in growing toward senior and technical-lead roles.

destinations.title: Small machines. Plenty to learn.
destinations.text:
I’m interested in Raspberry Pi homelabs and servers: a small place to explore how software lives beyond my own laptop.

There’s something satisfying about following a request through the layers—an app, a service, a machine, a network—and understanding where things fit.

The greenhouse idea

The miniature racks here are an illustration of that curiosity. They aren’t an inventory, a published tutorial, or a claim about production infrastructure.

destinations.title: A better question is a good start.
destinations.text:
I’m exploring AI-assisted work processes and AI-assisted web apps. What interests me is the useful part: helping turn an idea into something you can inspect, test, and improve.

Curious, not uncritical

I want to understand where assistance makes work clearer—and where careful human judgement still matters. An answer isn’t finished just because it sounds confident.

This observatory is a playful illustration, not a product demo or evidence of client outcomes.

destinations.title: Let’s find a workable next step.
destinations.text:
Have a contained problem or a small idea that needs a developer? I’m open to a conversation.

I’m employed full-time. Freelance work needs to fit remote, evening, or asynchronous collaboration, with a clear and manageable scope.
